_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session O1, step 3 of AMENDMENT_8 §5: OLMo-7B-hf, the method control with published per-dataset verdicts (Bordt et al. Table 3) and a public corpus, on the canon — h1b_rest (header, first token, feature) on one card, probe (row completion) on the other — compared cell by cell with the paper. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, the base of both Qwen pairs of block B, runs probe on the second card once OLMo's probe is done: that card is free for three hours of the session anyway, and the base needs the completion-mode canon row probe that the Nemo and Yandex models already have. No Russian file, no new amendment: every cell is preregistered. Priced by the rebuilt src/price_plan.py (every answer to its budget, x 1.15; replayed on all 26 completed runs, none above it): h1b_rest 4.3 h on one card; probe 1.5 h then Qwen probe 1.6 h on the other; neither model has been measured, so both are priced as the slower 12B family. Session about 4.7 h with downloads.
attached_input: none: the canon is fetched and hash-checked from its registered sources

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: header on the six canon files, first token on three, feature on five: the cells of Bordt et al. Table 3 other than row completion; 4.3 h. Context 2048 tokens; the longest query is a header prompt of about 370 tokens with its 1000-token budget
row completion on iris, wine, diabetes, titanic, adult; 1.5 h. Same weights as the first run, downloaded once; neither run frees them
queued on the card OLMo's probe frees; 1.6 h. Disk: OLMo's float32 checkpoint (about 28 GB) and Qwen's (about 15 GB) together are below the 49 GB the Nemo pair occupied in E1 and E2
